simple.meaning: שׁוֹא (shôwʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a tempest ; by implication, devastation.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Job 30:3. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוֹא (H7722) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שׁוֹא (shôwʼ) / H7722 is traced through Job 30:3, Job 30:14, Job 38:27, Psalms 35:8 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: They are gaunt from lack and famine.
As through a wide breach they come.
to satisfy the waste and desolate ground,
Let destruction come on him unawares.
Let destruction come on him unawares.
Lord, how long will you look on?
They shall be given over to the power of the sword.
when calamity overtakes you like a storm,
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear,
What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
Therefore disaster will come on you.
You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you, and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”
That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

definitions.full: H7722. sho [ שׁוֺא ] noun [masculine] ravage (?); — plural suffix שֹׁאֵיהֶם Psa 35:17 rescue me from their ravages (si vera lectio); ᵐ5 κακουργία ; Ol Dy Gr Che Comm. plausibly שַׁאֲגָם their roaring , compare 35:16 ; 35:17 c; We Du שֹׁאֲגִים . שֹׁאָה שׁוֺאָה, noun feminine devastation, ruin, waste ; — absolute ׳שׁו Isa 10:3 +, שֹׁאָה 47:11 ; Zeph 1:15 ; Job 30:14 (+ 38:27 van d. H. Gi, but see Baer's note); construct שֹׁאַת Prov 3:25 ; — 1 devastation, ruin , as coming on person, Isa 10:3 ; 47:11 (Babylon personified), Psa 35:8 ; a 63:10 ; רְשָׁעִים שֹׁאַת Prov 3:25 (object Genitive; || מַּחַד ); ׳(יוֺם)שׁ וּמְשׁוֺאָה Zeph 1:15 ; probably = devastating storm , in simile Ezek 38:9 (|| עָנָן ), Prov 1:27 (Qr; Kt שׁאוה ; || סוּפָה ). — Psa 35:8 b read probably שַׁחְתֹּה his pit , ᵑ6 We (compare 35:7 ). 2 concretely , ruin, waste , of the desert, Job 30:3 (reading אֶרֶץ for אֶמֶשׁ Ol; otherwise below 1 ), ׳שׁ וּמְשׁוֺאָה Job 38:27 (|| מִדְבָּר 38:26 ); = ruins 30:14 .
